description: This file implements RFC parameter management, including reading/writing parameters via files and HTTP requests, with support for JSON parsing and curl communication. It contains functions for initializing defaults, getting/setting parameters, and checking feature enablement.

methods.name: getRFCParameter
methods.description: Retrieves the value of an RFC parameter, either locally from files or via HTTP request.

methods.name: setRFCParameter
methods.description: Sets the value of an RFC parameter via HTTP request.

methods.name: getRFCErrorString
methods.description: Returns a string description for a given WDMP_STATUS error code.

methods.name: isRFCEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific RFC feature is enabled based on presence of its ini file.
